measures.title: Hotel Tax Proposition No. 1
measures.summary: Asks Tulsa voters to approve Ordinance No. 25830, which raises the city's excise tax on hotel room rents from 5% to 9.9%. The tax applies to the gross receipts from every occupancy of a hotel room in the city. If approved, the new rate takes effect January 1, 2027.
measures.yesMeans: The City of Tulsa hotel tax would rise from 5% to 9.9% starting January 1, 2027.
measures.noMeans: Ordinance No. 25830 would be void and the hotel tax would stay at 5%.
